item.title: Former Valley Stream lacrosse coach pleads guilty to sexual exploitation of children

item.title: Sea Cliff students participate in community culmination
item.description: Second-grade students at Sea Cliff School participated in a community culmination event on Friday, Jan. 30, showcasing an interdisciplinary unit focused on how communities function. During the event, each second-grade class created a miniature town inside its classroom.
